`NotoSansTelugu-Regular.ttf` is the variable Noto Sans Telugu font from
[Google Fonts](https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/notosanstelugu),
saved under a static filename so the PDF renderer's test can load it. It is a
test fixture, not a bundled application font. The accompanying `OFL.txt` is
its SIL Open Font License.
